## Five Academic Disciplines

Neuroformation™ sits at the intersection of five fields simultaneously:

| Discipline | Connection | Key Citations |
|---|---|---|
| D1 — Performance Coaching Methodology | 28+ year applied record is the primary validation dataset | Schmidt 1975, Ericsson et al. 1993, Vealey 2007 |
| D2 — Complex Adaptive Systems Theory | CSFC cascade model is CAS theory applied to identity systems | Wiener 1948, Friston 2010, Holland 1992 |
| D3 — Symbolic Logic & Recursive Cognition | Framework Forge process is recursive self-reference operational | Hofstadter 1979 |
| D4 — Computational Substrate Theory | χ²(4)=3.21, p=0.523 consistent with substrate-independence framework | Tegmark 2014, Chalmers 1996, Putnam 1967 |
| D5 — Narrative Identity Architecture | SIF→COLLAPSE is narrative identity disruption sequence | McAdams 1993, Ricoeur 1992, Herman 1992 |

**Best academic home:** 4E Cognition (embodied, embedded, enacted, extended) + Resilience Engineering
